تستصدروا (form X)
# تَسْتَصْدِرُوا (tastaṣdirū) /tas.tasˤ.di.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْدَرَ (istaṣdara)
# تُسْتَصْدَرُوا (tustaṣdarū) /tus.tasˤ.da.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْدَرَ (istaṣdara)
